title: Ichorous Gloves

sources.title: Ichorous Corrosion
markers: | summary = '''Ichorous Corrosion''' is a passive feature that applies noxious fumes on the user's targets when the user deals acid damage to them.

sources.title: Noxious Fumes (acid, condition)
markers: | effects = * Hostile creatures in a radius of {{Dist|m=3|ft=10}} take {{DamageText|1d4|Acid|drs=yes}} damage.

summary: Acid damage can apply Noxious Fumes to one target for 3 turns on a failed DC 13 Dexterity save.

fields.Ichorous Corrosion: The pinned source reports it applies once per turn and does not trigger from Fleshmelter Cloak acid.
fields.Noxious Fumes: At the start of each turn the affected creature takes 1d4 Acid. Hostile creatures within 10 ft of it also take 1d4 Acid. This is the acid status from the gloves.
fields.Base value: 90 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
